locale.message: Displays external references (backlinks) to articles from uploaded CSV data (SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Search Console). Shows referring domains, anchor text, and reference targets on article pages.
Configure backlink tracking by uploading CSV data and managing URL redirect mappings.
Enter the label used for repository/full-text galleys (e.g., REPO, Repository, Full Text). This helps the plugin match backlinks to both abstract and full-text URLs.
Enter domains to exclude from backlink display (one per line). Example: spamsite.com
Upload a CSV file mapping old URLs to new URLs after domain migration. Format: old_url,new_url
Use site-wide data (shared across all journals)
Enable this to share backlinks and redirect mappings across all journals. When enabled, uploading data to any journal will update it for all journals.
